description.narrative: Africa Rural Climate Adaptation Finance Mechanism Uganda (ARCAFIM Uganda) is an initiative led by the International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD) to bridge the gap between global and regional climate financing and the local needs for adaptation investment in Uganda. Through the Uganda country office, the contribution supports ARCAFIM’s work in Uganda and focuses on mobilising international financing for adaptation through key soft components, like linking funders and financial institutions, ensuring the use of international standards and working with producers and farmers, including women-led farms and enterprises.
